svg.aria-label: choose_next_letter, line by line, one line per step of the whole-program picture. Step 1: each letter's ID, keeping only the last 128. Step 2: token plus position embedding for each letter. Step 3: run the four blocks, keeping the state before block 1 and after each block. Step 4: the last block's result, and in it the last letter's row. Step 5: one last normalisation, giving the final hidden state. Step 6: 65 dot products plus biases, a score for each possible next letter; this is what the original code calls lm_head. Step 7: temperature, top-k, then softmax, giving the wheel. Step 8: a random point on the wheel picks the letter.
svg.text: choose_next_letter: the whole model, line by line
From readable_minigpt.py, with its comments taken out: the notes replace them

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: def choose_next_letter(text, model, temperature, keep_biggest, random_generator):

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: letter_ids = letters_to_ids(text)[-MOST_LETTERS_THE_MODEL_CAN_SEE:]

text.font-family: 'Bradley Hand', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

svg.text: step 1: each letter's ID; only the last 128 fit

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: starting_hidden_states = first_hidden_states(letter_ids, model)

text.font-family: 'Bradley Hand', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

svg.text: step 2: token + position embedding, per letter

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: hidden_states_after_each_block = run_all_blocks(starting_hidden_states, model)

text.font-family: 'Bradley Hand', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

svg.text: step 3: four blocks; keeps the state before

text.font-family: 'Bradley Hand', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

svg.text: block 1 and after each block

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: last_letters_hidden_state = hidden_states_after_each_block[-1][-1]

text.font-family: 'Bradley Hand', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

svg.text: step 4: the last block's result, last letter's row

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: final_hidden_state = normalise(last_letters_hidden_state, model.final_stretch, model.final_shift)

text.font-family: 'Bradley Hand', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

svg.text: step 5: one last normalisation: the final hidden state

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: scores = model.next_letter_rows @ final_hidden_state + model.next_letter_biases

text.font-family: 'Bradley Hand', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

svg.text: step 6: 65 dot products, plus biases: a score

text.font-family: 'Bradley Hand', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

svg.text: for each possible next letter (the original's lm_head)

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: chances = chances_from_scores(scores, temperature, keep_biggest)

text.font-family: 'Bradley Hand', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

svg.text: step 7: temperature, top-k, then softmax: the wheel

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: next_letter_id = spin_the_wheel(chances, random_generator)

text.font-family: 'Bradley Hand', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

svg.text: step 8: a random point on the wheel picks the letter

text.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: return VOCABULARY[next_letter_id]
